slot_scores.name: harry_fred_conflict_constraint
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about any conflict or compatibility restriction between Harry and Fred, nor about pairwise restrictions involving them.

slot_scores.name: harry_george_conflict_constraint
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether Harry and George can be selected together or whether there is any conflict between them.

slot_scores.name: george_implies_hermione_constraint
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about George implying Fred, but did not ask whether selecting George also requires Hermione.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no restriction preventing Harry and Fred from being selected together.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about Harry-Fred compatibility and then stated 'No other rules or costs apply.'

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no restriction preventing Harry and George from being selected together.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about Harry-George compatibility and then stated 'No other rules or costs apply.'

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Selecting George does not require selecting Hermione.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent only confirmed George→Fred and then stated 'No other rules or costs apply,' omitting the George→Hermione requirement.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while three P1 hidden constraints remained unresolved and explicitly assumed no other rules applied.

summary: The agent clarified the objective, Ginny requirement, group-size bounds, and George→Fred implication, but missed all three hidden P1 relationship constraints and prematurely declared the model ready with 'No other rules or costs apply.'

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
